newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brambles won't raise Ausdoc bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brambles won't raise Ausdoc bid.

text.p: Brambles Industries Ltd said on Tuesday it would not increase its A$2.00 per share bid for document exchange firm Ausdoc Group Ltd and expected its offer to lapse at the end of this month.
Brambles chief executive John Fletcher said the transport company believe Ausdoc was fully valued at the offer price but noted the independent valuation of up to A$2.61 per share.
Fletcher said Brambles would have raised its offer to A$2.10 to obtain the support of the Ausdoc board but the valuation meant the threshold of support was too high.
